```yaml
name: Copilot Setup Steps
on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'Cargo.toml'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'AGENTS.md'
      - '.github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'src/**'
      - 'Cargo.toml'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'AGENTS.md'
      - '.github/workflows/copilot-setup-steps.yml'

jobs:
  generate-context:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable

      - name: Install just
        run: |
          curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y
          source ~/.cargo/env
          cargo install just

      - name: Generate Rust Documentation
        run: |
          source ~/.cargo/env
          rustdoc --version
          cargo doc --no-deps --workspace

      - name: Extract TypeScript Definitions
        run: |
          # Extract TypeScript definitions from Rust bindings
          mkdir -p ts-definitions
          find . -name "*.rs" -exec grep -l "typescript\|ts\|js" {} \; | head -5 | xargs -I {} echo "Found: {}"

      - name: Analyze Code Structure
        run: |
          # Document source file organization
          mkdir -p code-analysis
          find src -name "*.rs" -type f | sort > code-analysis/file-structure.txt
          echo "Source files:" >> code-analysis/file-structure.txt
          find src -name "*.rs" -type f | wc -l >> code-analysis/file-structure.txt

      - name: Extract Configuration
        run: |
          # Extract key settings from Cargo.toml and package.json
          mkdir -p config-extraction
          echo "=== Cargo.toml ===" > config-extraction/config-summary.txt
          grep -E "(name|version|description)" Cargo.toml >> config-extraction/config-summary.txt
          echo "" >> config-extraction/config-summary.txt
          echo "=== package.json ===" >> config-extraction/config-summary.txt
          grep -E "(name|version|description)" package.json >> config-extraction/config-summary.txt

      - name: Map Test Information
        run: |
          # Map out testing architecture
          mkdir -p test-info
          find . -name "*test*" -type f | grep -E "\.(rs|js|ts)$" > test-info/test-files.txt
          echo "Test files found:" >> test-info/test-files.txt
          wc -l test-info/test-files.txt >> test-info/test-files.txt

      - name: Validate AGENTS.md
        run: |
          # Ensure AGENTS.md has required sections
          if [ ! -f "AGENTS.md" ]; then
            echo "Error: AGENTS.md not found"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          REQUIRED_SECTIONS=("Project Overview" "Development Workflow" "Code Conventions" "Testing Strategy" "Common Patterns" "Performance Considerations" "Debugging")
          for section in "${REQUIRED_SECTIONS[@]}"; do
            if ! grep -q "# $section" AGENTS.md; then
              echo "Missing section: $section"
              exit 1
            fi
          done
          echo "AGENTS.md validation passed"

      - name: Create AI Context Bundle
        run: |
          # Package all generated information
          tar -czf ai-context-bundle.tar.gz \
            code-analysis/ \
            config-extraction/ \
            test-info/ \
            Cargo.toml \
            package.json \
            AGENTS.md

      - name: Upload AI Context Bundle
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: ai-context-bundle
          path: ai-context-bundle.tar.gz
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Upload Rust Docs
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: rust-docs
          path: target/doc/
          retention-days: 7
```
